snippet.title: Return to Dark Castle - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the official trailer for Return to Dark Castle.

Return to Dark Castle revives the legendary Macintosh series that defined precision platforming and comic peril. 

Coming soon to Steam. Wishlist now!
